summary.text: Shelia Stubbs is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 78 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Henry Johnson.
Ballotpedia gives her Assembly tenure as beginning in 2019.

paragraphs.text: Shelia Stubbs was born in Camden, Arkansas, moved to Beloit, Wisconsin, at age five, and earned a bachelor's degree from Tougaloo College in 1993.
Her career experience includes working as a senior probation and parole agent and as a special education teacher.
Stubbs served on the Dane County Board of Supervisors, District 23, from 2006 to 2022.
She has been a member of the Assembly since 2019 and has served as chair of the Wisconsin Legislative Black Caucus.
Her 2025-2026 committee assignments are listed as Corrections, Energy and Utilities, and Health.
